1: # Changes
2: 
3: This file lists the changes of the last release cycle, one per line, for context only.
4: 
5: - The ingest pipeline now retries transient network errors three times before it fails the batch.
6: - The parser accepts trailing commas in configuration arrays and reports the line of every syntax error.
7: - The planner orders independent jobs by their declared priority before it considers their age.
8: - The scheduler skips a run when the previous run of the same job is still active.
9: - The executor streams command output to the log while the command runs instead of after it exits.
10: - The cache evicts the least recently used entry when it reaches its configured size.
11: - The ledger records the operator name with every manual correction.
12: - The exporter writes one file per day and compresses files older than a week.
13: - The auditor flags configuration files that changed outside a release window.
14: - The notifier batches alerts that arrive within one minute into a single message.
15: - The gateway rejects requests whose body exceeds the configured limit with a clear error.
16: - The archiver moves closed tickets to cold storage after ninety days.
17: - The indexer rebuilds its index in the background and swaps it in when it is complete.
18: - The renderer escapes every user value before it inserts the value into a template.
19: - The validator checks that every required field is present before it checks formats.
20: - The migrator refuses to run a migration twice and names the migration that already ran.
21: - The tracer samples one request in a hundred unless a request carries a debug header.
22: - The limiter counts requests per client over a sliding window of sixty seconds.
23: - The router retries an unavailable backend on the next healthy backend once.
24: - The signer rotates its key every thirty days and keeps the previous key for verification.
25: - The packer sorts archive entries by path so that archives are reproducible.
26: - The mirror copies new objects within five minutes and reports objects it could not copy.
27: - The janitor removes temporary files older than one day at midnight.
28: - The reporter includes the number of skipped records in every summary.
29: - The compressor chooses the fastest level for files smaller than one megabyte.
30: - The decoder reports the byte offset of the first invalid sequence it meets.
31: - The encoder normalizes line endings before it computes a checksum.
32: - The balancer drains a backend for one minute before it removes the backend.
33: - The crawler respects the crawl delay that a site publishes.
34: - The sampler keeps a fixed seed per job so that samples can be repeated.
35: - The profiler writes one flame graph per run and names it after the run.
36: - The watcher ignores editor swap files when it reports changed files.
37: - The fetcher stops following redirects after five hops.
38: - The linker reports every unresolved symbol instead of stopping at the first one.
39: - The merger keeps both versions of a conflicting line and marks the conflict.
40: - The splitter never cuts a record across two output files.
41: - The tagger adds the release number to every artifact it publishes.
42: - The ranker breaks ties by the earlier submission time.
43: - The mailer retries a failed delivery after one, five, and thirty minutes.
44: - The pinger marks a host as down after three missed replies in a row.

(End of file - total 44 lines)
</content>
